description: This file defines the abstract base class 'BaseAudioFilter' for implementing audio filters used in input transport processing within a speech processing pipeline. It provides method signatures for starting, stopping, processing control frames, and filtering audio data.

classes.name: BaseAudioFilter
classes.description: An abstract base class for audio filters that process audio data before VAD and downstream in input transport systems. It includes methods for lifecycle management, runtime configuration, and audio data filtering.

methods.name: start(self, sample_rate: int)
methods.description: Initializes the filter when the input transport starts, adjusting to the provided sample rate.

methods.name: stop(self)
methods.description: Cleans up resources when the input transport stops.

methods.name: process_frame(self, frame: FilterControlFrame)
methods.description: Processes runtime control frames to update filter settings or enable/disable the filter.

methods.name: bytes filter(self, audio: bytes)
methods.description: Applies the audio filter to the input audio data and returns the filtered audio.

ctags.name: filter
ctags.pattern: /^    async def filter(self, audio: bytes) -> bytes:$/
